name: wows-omp-plugin-omo-prometheus
description: Port of oh-my-openagent Prometheus planning and Atlas orchestration for OMP
license: SEE LICENSES IN LICENSE-MIT AND LICENSE-SUL-1.0

reviewLevel.description: Choose no plan review, the default review offer, routine Momus only, or Momus and Oracle on every plan

reviewRoundLimit.description: Most plan-review rounds per plan before asking whether to raise the limit or propose the plan as it stands; 0 or empty means unlimited

delivery.description: Ask how each plan delivers its work when the repository has a remote, or always plan direct commits, a pull request, or a pull request merged after CI

atlasWidget.description: Show live Atlas plan progress above the editor during execution

progressReports.description: Have Atlas tell you what each dispatch batch will do and how each task went

atlasRetry.description: How Atlas settles another retry window for a row that ran out of attempts: ask and wait, ask then approve or decline after atlasAskTimeout, or approve or decline without asking

atlasAmend.description: How Atlas settles a change to a row's acceptance criteria; an approval without you is still listed as a deviation you did not confirm

atlasRelease.description: How Atlas settles leaving execution once every row is done; decline keeps it active until /atlas exit

atlasAskTimeout.description: Minutes an ask-then-approve or ask-then-decline decision waits for your answer before its fallback applies

atlasAutoRetryLimit.description: Most retry windows per row granted without your answer; past it an approving atlasRetry declines instead; 0 means unlimited

herdrDag.description: Expose session-scoped Atlas snapshots to the Herdr DAG viewer
